facts.content: Agreed 30-day payment terms with Adriatic Foods for the wholesale contract

pages.title: Adriatic Foods
pages.html:
Adriatic Foods is a wholesale food distributor based in Split, employing around two hundred people as of 2026.

In July 2026 the company opened a new distribution warehouse in Zadar.

Suppliers must submit the RC-1 compliance form by 1 September 2026.
